newsitem.title: USA: W.R. Grace to buy food packager Schurpack.
newsitem.headline: W.R. Grace to buy food packager Schurpack.

text.p: W.R. Grace & Co on Monday announced that it has agreed in principle to purchase flexible food packaging manufacturer Schurpack Inc of St. Joseph, Mo., for an undisclosed sum.

Schurpack, a unit of Schur Group of Denmark, had 1996 sales of approximately $20 million. It is a leading supplier of plastic laminate packaging materials for cook-in foods for institutions and supermarkets. Schurpack also co-extrudes and converts film for the meat and cheese and hygienic industries.
The transaction, subject to approval by the Grace board, is expected to close in the second quarter.
